card.title: Pre-register for Sparta features
card.dismissed: You won't see this notice again

AI_PLANNER.name: AI plan assistant
AI_PLANNER.hook: Set a goal and a deadline, and the assistant plans your pace
description: Tell it your target exam, the time left and what to cover, and it recommends how far to go each day, with a progress rate and study range.
It keeps refining the plan to fit your goal and pace.
bullets: Recommends a daily study range and progress rate for your goal and deadline
Miss a day and it reworks the plan around the days left
Reminds you right on time of your planned start and what's left to do

AI_REPORT.name: AI focus report
AI_REPORT.hook: When you sat for hours but nothing stuck
description: Get a weekly report that looks back on your study.
It also suggests next week's plan to do more of what worked and less of what broke your focus.
bullets: See at a glance which days and times you focus best
Points out the times and subjects where you often broke off
Suggests when to place hard subjects in next week's plan

GROUP_MATCHING.name: Group study matching
GROUP_MATCHING.hook: When you keep slacking off alone
description: It finds people who match your goal and study hours.
Study alongside people with the same goal and keep each other motivated.
bullets: Pick a goal like TOEIC, civil service or college entrance and we'll match a room
Connects you with people who study at your usual time, like mornings or nights
No need to find or create a room. One tap and you're studying together

PHONE_CALL.name: Phone call reminders
PHONE_CALL.hook: Put it off, and your phone rings
description: When your planned study time comes, it calls you instead of sending a notification.
Notifications are easy to swipe away, but you answer a call, so you sit right down.
bullets: Calls you at your planned start time to get you studying
If you don't answer, it calls again a few minutes later
When you pick up, it tells you today's tasks right away

TIMER_BACKGROUND.name: Premium timer backgrounds
TIMER_BACKGROUND.hook: A screen you'll want to stay with
description: Decorate your study timer with premium-only backgrounds.
Pick one that fits your mood and start studying.
bullets: Choose backgrounds with different moods, like a café, a library or a late-night desk
Set a background for each subject and switch into study mode the moment you sit down

CHARACTER_ITEMS.name: Wear character items
description: Pick character items and dress up your character.
bullets: Pick a hat, an outfit and an accessory and wear them all together
Make even the same character your own with your own combination
